A refined take on classic workwear, the Dowler Boots in cool pebbled leather give you an entirely modern look that will outlast trends. Solidly constructed, wearing a pair gives you a sense of protection without the heaviness you find with similar boots. Over time the leather will start to conform to the shape of your feet and develop a warm patina. When you want the robustness of a boot with a refined profile, these are the ones for you.
This product is made from full-grain calfskin leather sourced from a Gold-Rated tannery based in Arzignano, Italy. Being the highest level of recognition awarded by the Leather Working Group, a Gold rating signifies the leather manufacturer meets the most stringent criteria and demonstrates a strong commitment to mitigating its environmental impact.

p-ghbass-14922819666288.d: Iconic nautical style. Anchored in 90 years of Weejuns® heritage, the G.H.BASS Greenwich loafer exudes a timeless boat shoe sensibility. Its premium full-grain leather upper features classic 180 construction, handsewn moccasin stitching, and a woven vamp for showstopping style. Leather lacing, plus a leather insole and outsole deliver a customizable, comfortable fit and a casual aesthetic that never quits. Note: This style runs big. We recommend sizing down ½ size.

p-velasca-3744207798349.d:
Calfskin brushed with wool meets cashmere fabric and welcomes the world of tailoring in this shoe with a casual heart, designed by Fabio Attanasio for Velasca. The leather sole has a small rubber island so, together with the integrated sole, each step will be more comfortable. Wear it with sportex or with lapeled denim.

p-ironheart-10280679407882.d: Made in Japan by ROTOTO, this classic beanie is knitted from an acrylic/wool blend to offer an optimum balance of warmth and durability. The seamless construction provides greater comfort and styling versatility, allowing the beanie to be worn facing any direction — either rolled or unrolled for full ear coverage. This acrylic/wool blend features multicoloured flecks woven into the knit to create a distinctive ‘nep’ effect, with the fibres intentionally showing through the face for enhanced texture and visual depth.

p-velasca-4812765659213.d:
Laced boots with stitching on the toe, in smooth brushed calf leather, are inspired by the bohemian way of life; but take a look to the details: they will captivate you with their elegance, thanks to the leather sole and the shiny leather outside. The double blake-rapid stitching makes these shoes solid, built to last in time. Inside, the integrated insole follows the shape of your foot to give you comfort at every step; under the insole, the craftsman has inserted another soft layer to insulate the foot and make them even more comfortable. The eyelets are silver-coloured, but instead of the classic eyelets on the end of the throatline, you will find four refined hooks: they will make your boot as informal as it is memorable. Wear them with jeans with exposed selvedge, a cream-coloured t-shirt and a woolen jacket.
Made in Montegranaro (Italy)

p-velasca-3781797969997.d:

And a flat cap, should the wind become more sprightly.
Made in Montegranaro (Italy).

p-velasca-6836989189.d: It's the Oxford that wants to be elegant, and to be free to wear brown at the same time. With its full-grain leather, leather sole with classic aesthetics, it’s a versatile dark brown shoe for less formal occasions. Match it with a grey suit at the office, or with a mismatched ensemble at the happy-hour drinks besides the lake. And its blake-rapid construction makes it very easy to resole.
